title: Great Tour
text: We were picked up at the AirBnB by our tour guide in a taxi van. The driver took us up to Park Guell and dropped us right at the entrance. The guide got us immediately through the gate and we spent about an hour being shown the highlights of the park. Then the taxi picked us up and took us to Sagrada Familia. We again were dropped at entrance and the guide got us immediately through the gate. He pointed out the highlights in the museum and the church for about an hour and then we were able to go back and take a second look at points of interest.
author: Suzie_G

title: Great guide
text: Our guide was amazing.  He had a deep knowledge of the area and was able to answer all our questions.
author: Ernest_W

title: Our tour guide, Steven,...
text: Our tour guide, Steven, was extremely knowledgeable on the sites we visited, Guell Park and Segrada Familia. On the drive from the hotel he pointed out lots of historical spots. He even spent time at the end telling us great spots to eat and other sites that we might want to visit on the rest of our trip.  I would highly recommend.
author: Carrie_M

title: Great Private Tour!!
text: Our original group tour of the Sagrada Familia was cancelled after we arrived due to Pope Leo's visit while we were here. This private tour was the only one we could find on short notice. It was great!! Our guide Clara picked us up at our hotel and spent ~4 hrs with us at Park Guell & the Sagrada Familia. She was very knowledgeable and gave us a great insight of both locations. Highly recommend this tour!!
author: ANTHONY_C

title: Great Experience
text: Steve had a taxi waiting for us when we got off the ship, just as scheduled. He was wonderful gentleman and a seasoned guide with a wealth of knowledge about Gaudi’s work. I would definitely recommend this tour to anyone interested in Park Guell and Sagrada Família.
author: Keith_A

title: Best tour guide ever!
text:
This was a very last minute booking due to an unfortunate issue with our previously booked Viator tour.
Rose stepped in at the last minute as our tour guide and was absolutely amazing, so full of wonderful information and customization to give us one of the best experiences ever!  The Família Sagrada was a bucket list for all of us, and without Rose, would not have happened.
This was far better than we ever imagined… thank you so much for your kindness and for showing us the beauty of both the Sagrada and Park Guell!
author: Claire_H

author: Lenny_S

title: Our guide Stephen was...
text: Our guide Stephen was sitting in the lobby waiting for us, he was so quiet that we walked right past him at first! Luckily we messaged the tour and he was able to introduce himself. The taxi ride was very smooth and starting at the park was great, we loved learning about the history and building techniques of the era. Then we went to the sagrada familia where the guide got us in very quickly and we had tons of time to learn about the history and the artists. Overall would recommend to friends, such a wonderful private experience!
author: Danielle_R
